record.rsp_body:
@echo off
echo "-----start build-2.bat-----"
:: param1-----node zip name
:: ---------------------------prepare node path--------------------------------------
set node_path=D:\%1\necho "node_path:"%node_path%
::set path=%node_path%;C:\Program Files\WinRAR;%path%
echo "path:"%path%
set origin_folder=%~dp0
echo %origin_folder%
cd ..
set parent_folder=%cd%
set tool_folder=%parent_folder%\dev_tools
echo tool_folder%tool_folder%
cd %origin_folder%
set SASS_BINARY_PATH=%tool_folder%\win32-x64-64_binding.node
:: ---------------------------prepare build path--------------------------------------
set dist_folder=D:/dist
echo "dist folder:" %dist_folder%
set current_folder=%~dp0
echo "current folder:" %current_folder%

:: check environments
echo "-----check node version-----"
call node -v

echo "-----check npm version-----"
call npm -v

echo "-----check npm config list-----"
call npm config list

echo "-----check ng version-----"
call ng version


:: ---------------------------waf cli-----------------------------------
::call npm install -g @waf_cli/cli
::    if %errorlevel%==0 (
::        @echo "-----global install waf cli succeed! current version:-----"
::        call waf -V
::    ) else (
::        @echo "-----global install waf cli failed! -----"
::        goto end
::    )

:: ---------------------------waf build---------------------------------
call waf init %current_folder%/..
call waf build -w %current_folder%
    if %errorlevel%==0 (
        @echo "-----waf build succeed! dist directory: -----"
        @echo %dist_folder%
    ) else (
        @echo "-----waf build failed!-----"
        goto end
    )

:end
echo "-----end build-2.bat-----"

record.rule_name: 疑似访问/下载脚本文件
record.rsp_body:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# This script prints the release version for emqx

# ensure dir
cd -P -- "$(dirname -- "$0")"

if [ -f EMQX_ENTERPRISE ]; then
    EDITION='enterprise'
else
    EDITION='opensource'
fi

## emqx_release.hrl is the single source of truth for release version
RELEASE="$(grep -E "define.+EMQX_RELEASE.+${EDITION}" include/emqx_release.hrl | cut -d '"' -f2)"

git_exact_vsn() {
    local tag
    tag="$(git describe --tags --match "[e|v]*" --exact 2>/dev/null)"
    echo "${tag#[e|v]}"
}

GIT_EXACT_VSN="$(git_exact_vsn)"
if [ "$GIT_EXACT_VSN" != '' ]; then
